s-1.ptxt: Remove Headlight NO.1 Bulb (Halogen Headlight Type)

s2.ptxt: Turn the headlight bulb NO.1 in the direction indicated by the arrow in the illustration and remove it.

atten3.ptxt: Do not touch the glass portion of the bulb.

s2.ptxt: Turn the headlight cover in the direction indicated by the arrow in the illustration and remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Discharge Headlight Bulb (Discharge Headlight Type)

s2.ptxt: Turn in the direction indicated by the arrow in the illustration and disconnect the socket of the headlight light control computer assembly LH.
In the order shown in the illustration, release the set spring lock and remove the discharge headlight bulb.

atten3.ptxt: Do not touch the glass portion of the bulb.

s2.ptxt: Turn the headlight bulb NO.2 in the direction indicated by the arrow in the illustration and remove it.

atten3.ptxt: Do not touch the glass portion of the bulb.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Turn Signal Light Bulb

s2.ptxt: Turn in the direction indicated by the arrow in the illustration and remove the front turn signal light bulb together with the front turn signal light socket.
Remove the front turn signal light bulb from the front turn signal light socket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Turn Signal Light Socket

s2.ptxt: Turn in the direction indicated by the arrow in the illustration and remove the clearance light bulb together with the clearance light socket.
Remove the clearance light bulb from the clearance light socket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Headlight Light Control Computer Assembly LH (Discharge Headlight Type)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 screws and separate the headlight light control computer assembly LH.
Disconnect the connector and remove the headlight light control computer assembly LH.

atten3.ptxt: Once removed, be sure to replace it with a service headlight gasket, as it may cause water leakage.
